Markets.title: Dow slumps over 500 pts as Fed minutes revive rate-hike fears
Markets.summary: The Dow plunged over 500 points while the Nasdaq rose as investors reacted to Nvidia's earnings and Federal Reserve minutes signaling potential interest rate hikes to combat inflation. Meanwhile, retail companies like Target and TJX released positive holiday forecasts despite the broader market volatility.

Markets.title: Fed policymakers focused on inflation risks in October, with some seeing need for bigger rate hike
Markets.summary: At their October meeting, Federal Reserve officials kept interest rates steady but discussed a potential half-percentage-point increase due to persistent inflation risks. Policymakers remain concerned that inflation will not ease quickly enough, which may lead to intense debates at the upcoming December meeting.

Markets.title: Market Trading Guide: Deepak Fertilisers among 3 stock recommendations for Thursday
Markets.summary: Indian stock benchmarks declined due to weak global cues and profit-taking, with the Nifty dropping 0.63% and the Sensex falling 0.61%. Despite the market downturn, analyst Sachin Gupta recommended bullish trades on Vijaya, Eureka Forbes, and Deepak Fertilisers.

Markets.title: Dalmia Bharat to consider share buyback at Nov 23 board meeting
Markets.summary: Dalmia Bharat's board will meet on November 23 to consider a proposal for sharing a buyback of its fully paid-up equity shares. Additionally, the cement manufacturer plans to expand its production capacity to 75 million tonnes per annum by fiscal year 2028.

Markets.title: Target reports strongest quarterly sales gain in five years heading into the holiday shopping season
Markets.summary: Target reported a 7.1 percent increase in third-quarter net sales to $27.07 billion, marking its strongest quarterly sales gain in five years. The growth was driven by a revitalized product lineup, expanded same-day deliveries, and price cuts across various income groups.

Markets.title: Nasdaq gains in choppy trade as Nvidia outlook lifts AI mood; Anthropic pricing awaited
Markets.summary: The Nasdaq rose due to Nvidia's positive revenue guidance, while the Dow Jones and S&P 500 fell due to losses in finance and healthcare. Investors are now watching Anthropic's upcoming IPO to gauge market enthusiasm for AI ventures.

Geo-Political.title: Inside the old gas pipeline where Ukraine is fighting an underground war with Russia
Geo-Political.summary: BBC journalist Jonathan Beale accompanied Ukrainian forces fighting Russian troops inside an underground gas pipeline. This subterranean tactic allows Ukrainian soldiers to battle away from the detection of Russian drones.

Geo-Political.title: 'The drones don't fly here' - BBC reports from Ukraine's new front line
Geo-Political.summary: BBC reporters visited a new front line in Ukraine's Kharkiv region where local forces are fighting Russian troops inside an old Soviet tunnel. Soldiers at the site noted that drones cannot fly in this underground location.

Geo-Political.title: Israeli military launches rare ground operation in Gaza beyond Yellow Line
Geo-Political.summary: The Israeli military launched a rare ground operation beyond the Yellow Line in Gaza to dismantle a tunnel network. Hamas condemned the incursion as a flagrant violation of the ceasefire.

Geo-Political.title: William and Kate meet PM Modi as they wrap up India tour
Geo-Political.summary: Prince William and Kate met with Prime Minister Narendra Modi in New Delhi to conclude their tour of India. Their trip also included an appearance at the annual Earthshot Prize.

Geo-Political.title: Kuwait says it repelled first Iranian attack in two months after US strikes island
Geo-Political.summary: Following a U.S. airstrike on the Iranian island of Qeshm, Iran launched attacks against Kuwait and Bahrain. This marked Kuwait's first repelled attack by Iran in two months.

AI & Tech.title: REA: The Open-Source AI Tool That Can Reverse Engineer Almost Anything (2026 Guide)
AI & Tech.summary: REA is a new open-source AI tool that allows users to understand how applications work without accessing their source code. It eliminates the need to spend months learning disassemblers and reading assembly code to analyze app features.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator found their WordPress SaaS course recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best course in that category. This unexpected placement occurred without the use of paid advertising or traditional optimization techniques.

AI & Tech.summary: This article outlines ten essential artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These applications help digital creators streamline their workflows and maintain a competitive edge in an evolving digital landscape.

Data & Insights.title: UK inflation hits one-year high of 3.6%: Why are markets less convinced of another rate hike? | Explained
Data & Insights.summary: UK inflation rose to a one-year high of 3.6% in October due to increased fuel prices and tobacco taxes. Despite this increase, steady core and services inflation reduced market expectations for a December Bank of England rate hike.

Data & Insights.title: Trump, Xi, Putin unite $1.48 Trillion military might at Shenzhen: Will nukes be on the table? Why it matters
Data & Insights.summary: US President Donald Trump has arrived in Shenzhen, China, for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit. He is scheduled to hold a high-stakes meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin on Thursday.

Data & Insights.title: Soybean oil's share rises in India's edible oil import mix
Data & Insights.summary: In the 2025-26 period, India imported 5.83 million tonnes of soybean oil. This quantity contributed to a total edible oil import volume of 16.92 million tonnes, reflecting an increased market share for soybean oil.

Data & Insights.title: Union Budget 2027-28: FICCI seeks graded LTCG taxation,  ₹100 lakh crore in credit for manufacturing growth
Data & Insights.summary: FICCI has recommended restoring the long-term capital gains tax exemption on listed securities for the Union Budget 2027-28. The industry body is also advocating for a calibrated increase in the securities transaction tax.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer: What FM's pre-budget stakeholder consultations mean
Data & Insights.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman is holding pre-budget consultations with industry executives, bankers, market participants, and social sector experts over the coming days. For the first time, these discussions will also include young people and retired bureaucrats.

India.title: Pak Minister Set For India Visit Had Made "Cut Hands" Threat Over Indus Waters Treaty
India.summary: Pakistan's Climate Minister Musadik Malik is scheduled to visit India despite previously threatening "cut hands" over the Indus Waters Treaty earlier this year. New Delhi suspended the 1960 water-sharing agreement following the 2025 Pahalgam terror attack in Kashmir.

India.title: GTA 6 Launches In India, Brings A Whole New World To Vice City
India.summary: GTA 6 has launched in India after achieving over $1 billion in global pre-orders. The highly anticipated release is on track to break sales records for any entertainment product in history.

India.title: From Kala Pani To A New Prison Policy: Andaman-Nicobar To Scrap 130-Year-Old Prisons Act
India.summary: The Andaman and Nicobar Islands are replacing the 130-year-old Prisons Act with the Andaman and Nicobar Islands Prisons and Correctional Services Regulation, 2026. This new regulation aims to reform prison administration and move away from the colonial-era penal system.

India.title: Woman's Body Found In Garbage Pile In Uttarakhand: Cops
India.summary: Police in Uttarakhand found a woman's body in a garbage pile. Investigators believe she was murdered at another location and her body was dumped there to hide the crime.

India.title: Baby Separated From Parents After Kaziranga Crash Reunited With Family
India.summary: An infant separated from its parents following a car crash in Kaziranga, Assam, has been reunited with its family. Medical staff cared for the baby while the parents recovered from critical injuries sustained in the accident.

India.title: 8-Car Convoy Of Liquor Smugglers Try To Mow Down Police Team In Gujarat
India.summary: An eight-car convoy of liquor smugglers attempted to mow down a police team in Gujarat during a chase. The speeding vehicles severely injured a cow while escaping across the border into Rajasthan.

General.title: 'The drones don't fly here' - BBC reports from Ukraine's new front line
General.summary: Ukrainian forces are fighting Russian troops inside an old Soviet tunnel in the Kharkiv region. The BBC is reporting from this new front line where combat is taking place.

General.title: UK government asks for Russell Brand's YouTube account to be removed
General.summary: The UK government has asked YouTube to remove Russell Brand's account. This request follows a video message from his wife in which Brand claimed he is innocent.

General.title: Typical energy bill forecast to go up by £443 a year from January as inflation rate rises again
General.summary: Typical UK energy bills are forecast to increase by £443 a year, or 26%, starting in January. This projected rise follows a sharp increase in the country's annual inflation rate.

General.title: Heating bills, chocolate and cat food: What the inflation figures mean for you
General.summary: UK inflation has reached its fastest pace in a year, and energy costs are set to rise further. These increases will directly impact household expenses like heating bills, chocolate, and cat food.

General.title: Council wins legal fight against flags on lamp-posts
General.summary: A judge granted an interim injunction in favor of a council regarding the placement of flags on lamp-posts. The decision was based on a "compelling need" to take legal action.
